news.text: #JUVE, AND HE PAYS#Elkann is taking care of itA new capital increase is plannedThe financial statement closes at -66. #Exor injects 250 million.Another recapitalization to guarantee sporting competitiveness, the development of assets and the brand, as well as the sustainability of the club. [Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#ELKANN, ANOTHER 250 MILLION FOR #JUVEA 66 million deficit, the ownership immediately injects 60: since 2007, 1.5 billion have been paid in.The Board of Directors approves the deficit for the 2025-26 fiscal year: on November 3, a shareholders meeting will decide the timing of the new capital injection. Meanwhile #Massara is moving for #Romano. #Owusu is also KO. Caution regarding #Conceição.[Front Page TuttoSport]

✍️‼️ "#Juventus is evaluating a one-year contract extension for #DouglasLuiz, which could be useful both technically and to reduce the amortization impact on the balance sheet. The Brazilian has been revitalized by #Spalletti and there would already be some first signs of a potential agreement: the bianconero club is concretely considering it."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 "#DouglasLuiz stayed at #Juventus because Luciano #Spalletti always had the curiosity to evaluate him.But above all, it was because no permanent offers arrived: a loan deal would have been very difficult.His performance has been good and his attitude has been correct.Even so, he still needs to add certain elements to become a more complete player."[@romeoagresti on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

👀 "#Juventus never thought about sending Nico #González back to #AtléticoMadrid on loan.A swap deal with #Sørloth could have left everyone satisfied, but the Spaniards were not open to this option.The bianconeri always said that a satisfactory offer would have to be presented.There were also inquiries from Serie A, but never any official offers."[@romeoagresti on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

👀 "There is no apparent rush at #Juventus regarding contract renewals, as there would be no need to accelerate on that front.The only exception would be Pierre #Kalulu, because his extension was already planned.His renewal could become one of the next major news updates from the club."[@romeoagresti on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

#Juve Board of DirectorsWith a return to sporting results in line with the historical average, a significant improvement is projected starting from the 2027/28 financial year. The management has been completely renewed and the outstanding legal or financial issues of the past are closed: UEFA, the legal proceeding in Rome and the IMG dispute, with a collection of 22 mln.[Marco Baridon]

#Juventus Board of DirectorsCosts 📉 to 42 mln (with no cuts to investments for sporting competitiveness). Sponsorship revenues are 📈 to 120 mln and the debt structure is more balanced, thanks to the 150 mln bond.Record revenues from the league, Stadium Tours and Museum, with stadium occupancy reaching 97.6%[Marco Baridon]

The #Juventus Board of Directors has approved the financial statements as of June 30, 2026. A loss of 66 million, in line with the forecasts.A proposal for a capital increase has been put forward, with the support of #EXOR, which is ready to immediately advance 60 million. This is a concrete sign of confidence in the club's value.[Marco Baridon]

👀👦🏻 Davide #Marchisio, Claudio's son, born in 2009, who recently signed his first professional contract, trained today at la Continassa alongside the First Team and the #NextGen players that stayed in Turin.[IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]

📊 #Juventus, financial statements as of 30/6/26 approved: loss of 66 mln, in line with forecasts.📉 Operating costs -42 mln🤝 Sponsor >120 mln🏟️ Stadium at 97.6%💰 150 mln bondA capital increase has been proposed: #EXOR will immediately advance 60 mln. ⚪⚫[IlBianconero]

❌‼️ The news of Ginevra becoming president of #Juventus has no foundation. She is a woman who has nothing to do with sports and football: it would sound like a bizarre choice to me. I find it difficult to think that a person who until today has been involved in cinema could become the president of la Vecchia Signora. We conducted a check directly with the bianconero club and we received a negative result.[Guido Vaciago - TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

#Juventus has closed the 2025-26 financial statements with a loss of 66 million. The Board of Directors has decided to propose a capital increase of 250 million to the shareholders meeting. #Exor has already announced that it will cover its respective share and will immediately provide 60 million. The rumor regarding Ginevra #Elkann moving towards the presidency has been denied.[Giovanni Albanese]
Ginevra #Elkann heading toward the presidency of #Juventus.[Matteo Moretto]

#Juventus loses another midfielder to injury: Augusto #Owusu, who has been joined to #Spalletti's first team for some time to make up for the absences, has run into a muscular problem that will keep him away from the pitch for about 2-3 weeks.[Mirko Nicolino]
